H435.title: the probe reproduces the campaign's recorded quantum/tempo verdicts (by construction)
H435.metric: reproduction agreement 0.959 on 219 committed cells (abstain rate 0.00); one-axis comparator 0.959 vs two-axis 0.959 on the common basis (beat +0.000); coupling-reads-TEMPO 0; canonical 8x4 all-match True (a threshold-consistency check, not generalization)
H435.note: The probe reads the SAME Bongaarts-Feeney decomposition the campaign's dynamical verdicts were derived from, so high agreement is REPRODUCTION BY CONSTRUCTION - an internal-consistency check, not independent validation. On the common basis a fair one-axis persistence-only classifier reproduces the coarse labels about as well (beat +0.000), so the aggregate agreement does not earn the composition axis; that discrimination is H436's job, not this hypothesis's. Zero coupling levers read TEMPO because coupling never touches the tempo channel f[3] - a construction fact, not a discovered safety property.

H436.title: the composition axis is necessary, not decorative
H436.metric: one-axis (persistence) wrong in 8/8; two-axis TEMPO in 8/8 (one archetype - the tempo push - across 8 regions)
H436.note: On the pure tempo push, persistence reads high (the durable fec residual from a lower mean age), so a durability-only rule calls it QUANTUM - wrongly - while the two-axis rule reads tempo_share and tags TEMPO. The second axis fixes a real error, so it is not slop. This is the round's genuinely falsifiable core; it is demonstrated on one mechanism across 8 correlated regions, not 8 independent levers.

H437.title: cash-mirage splits into a Bongaarts-Feeney mirage and a durability mirage
H437.metric: eroding-reverts 8/8; durable-persists 8/8; tempo-confusions 0/16 (~0 BY CONSTRUCTION - cash routes to f[2])
H437.note: Composition-quantum for cash is BY CONSTRUCTION (cash writes the quantum channel f[2], never the tempo channel f[3]), so the 0 tempo-confusions are not evidence. The measured, falsifiable content is the durability split: the eroding variant reverts (survive < 40, largely the withdrawn-funding envelope by design) while the durable variant, held constant, still persists (survive > 60) - a genuine dynamical outcome the model could have overturned. 'Cash = mirage' conflates borrowed timing with withdrawn funding; the durability read separates them.

H438.title: full-catalogue reclassification screen
H438.metric: 9/219 probe-vs-campaign disagreements (rate 0.041, 1 shape(s) {('weak / stall', 'QUANTUM-DURABLE'): 9}); load-bearing contradictions 0
H438.note: The screen reproduces the coarse labels on the committed set; the residual disagreements are reported NEUTRALLY as interpretations the probe offers (it reads a durable adjTFR* gain where the coarse label said weak/stall), NOT proven corrections - the notebook has no ground truth beyond the same model, so it cannot adjudicate the probe right. No quantum-family escape is read as TEMPO. PARTIAL: reproduces most labels, disagreements interpretable but unproven.

H439.title: composition is region-portable; durability is position-dependent
H439.metric: campaign variation-capable levers 1 (portable True); synthetic mixed stress range [0.67]; ranges cash_eroding 0.00~0constr, coupling_crown 0.00~0constr, tempo_push 0.10*, cash_durable_parity 0.01~0constr, mixed_cash+tempo 0.67(synth)
H439.note: Portability is a CONSTRUCTION ARTIFACT for the non-tempo levers: cash, coupling and durable parity never touch f[3], so their tempo_share is ~0 in every region by construction, not by finding. The campaign has exactly one variation-capable archetype (the tempo push), which is portable but marginal (range near 0.10, just under the 0.15 bar). A synthetic mixed cash+tempo lever, added to actually stress the claim, is NOT portable (tempo_share swings 0.00-0.67 across regions), so the property does NOT generalize to genuinely mixed levers. survive_pct still spreads with basin - the intended position signal. PARTIAL: portable for the campaign's single-channel and tempo levers, but the claim rests on construction-zeros and fails for a mixed lever.

H440.title: the classification is robust to the one calibrated tempo constant
H440.metric: class flips across kBF in {0.6, 1.0}: 0 (12 lever x anchor cells)
H440.note: No canonical lever changes class between the E40 damped kBF=0.6 and the E41-adjudicated undamped kBF=1.0. A fair robustness check: a class could have flipped if the tempo push crossed 0.60. The verdict is a property of the intervention, not an artefact of the tempo calibration.

summary.title: The Quantum-Effect Probe (H435-H440)
summary.reframe: E48 is a DIAGNOSTIC INSTRUMENT that operationalizes the model's own Bongaarts-Feeney quantum-vs-tempo split. It reads the same decomposition the campaign's verdicts were derived from, so agreement with those verdicts REPRODUCES the model's own classifications by construction - it does not independently validate them. The meaningful, falsifiable comparator is one-axis (persistence only) vs two-axis (composition + durability): the composition axis earns its keep specifically on the tempo push (H436), not in aggregate catalogue agreement (H435). 'Zero coupling reads TEMPO' is a construction fact (coupling never touches the tempo channel), not a discovered safety property.
summary.headline: The probe REPRODUCES the model's own quantum/tempo classifications by construction (agreement 96% on the committed set); on the same basis a fair one-axis comparator does about as well (beat +0.000), so the composition axis is earned specifically on the tempo push (H436: one-axis wrong 8/8), not in aggregate. The measured durability split separates a withdrawn-funding mirage from a Bongaarts-Feeney timing mirage (H437: eroding-reverts 8/8, durable-persists 8/8). tempo_share portability is a construction artifact for non-tempo levers; the campaign has only 1 variation-capable archetype and a synthetic mixed lever is not portable, so the property does not generalize (H439). The classification is kBF-robust (0 flips, H440). Backfire and migration levers (33 region-runs) are out of scope; NULL mappings (21) carry no verdict; 0 committed-set abstentions (MIXED) are not counted as agreement.
